   291	# exactly the inference BEN-041 records failing to make. Both the flag and both

   293	# ROOTs, so an absent announcement is informative and not a version gap.
   294	_BKG_MODE_ANNOUNCE = "[INFO] bkg-mode="
   295	_PURITY_SIGNATURE = "[INFO] measured training:"

   298	def classify_log_bkg_mode(text):
   299	    """Return (mode, reason) for one unfold log. mode is a member of KNOWN_BKG_MODES, or
   300	    None when the log cannot decide -- which callers must treat as UNPROVABLE, not as
   301	    'probably fine'."""
   302	    announced = None
   303	    for line in text.splitlines():
   304	        i = line.find(_BKG_MODE_ANNOUNCE)
   305	        if i >= 0:
   306	            tail = line[i + len(_BKG_MODE_ANNOUNCE):]
   307	            tok = tail.split(":", 1)[0].strip()
   308	            if tok in KNOWN_BKG_MODES:
   309	                if announced is not None and announced != tok:
   310	                    return None, f"log announces conflicting modes {announced!r} and {tok!r}"
   311	                announced = tok
   312	            else:
   313	                return None, f"log announces unrecognized bkg-mode {tok!r}"
   314	    if announced is not None:
   315	        if announced == "purity":
   316	            # the purity branch never announces; an announcement claiming purity means the
   317	            # log did not come from this driver's known print set.
   318	            return None, "log announces bkg-mode=purity, which this driver's purity branch never prints"
   319	        return announced, f"driver announced bkg-mode={announced}"
   320	    if _PURITY_SIGNATURE in text:
   321	        return "purity", ("no bkg-mode announcement + build_measured_training_nd signature "
   322	                          "present => purity branch (the silent branch)")
   323	    return None, ("no bkg-mode announcement and no measured-training signature; the run may "
   324	                  "have been non-verbose, so the branch is unprovable from this log")

   399	def require_candidate_path(path):
   400	    """Positive allowlist + negative denylist: a candidate MUST live under the
   401	    candidate subdir and MUST NOT match any adopted/protected token. Prevents both
   402	    the round-2 self-rejection (candidate name containing '_final') and any write
   403	    onto an adopted/central path."""
   404	    # repair-5 (defect 4a). History: this was first a bare substring test, then a
   405	    # normpath component match -- and the verifier defeated the second one too, because a
   406	    # component match succeeds ANYWHERE the sequence appears, so
   407	    # `/evil/active_universe_5d/standard/candidate/out.root` passed, and normpath does not
   408	    # resolve symlinks. Containment must be RESOLVED and anchored to this repository:
   409	    # realpath both sides, then require commonpath(candidate_root, target) == candidate_root.
   410	    cand_root = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(ND_ROOT, CANDIDATE_SUBDIR))
   411	    # Callers pass repo-relative ("nd-unfolding/active_universe_5d/...") or ND-relative
   412	    # ("active_universe_5d/...") paths depending on where they cd to, so resolve a relative
   413	    # path against BOTH known roots and accept it if either lands inside. An absolute path is
   414	    # taken as given. Resolution is realpath, so symlinks cannot smuggle a target out.
   415	    if os.path.isabs(path):
   416	        cands = [path]
   417	    else:
   418	        cands = [os.path.join(ND_ROOT, path), os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, path)]
   419	    resolved, inside = None, False
   420	    for c in cands:
   421	        t = os.path.realpath(c)
   422	        if resolved is None:
   423	            resolved = t
   424	        try:
   425	            if os.path.commonpath([cand_root, t]) == cand_root and t != cand_root:
   426	                resolved, inside = t, True
   427	                break
   428	        except ValueError:                 # different drives / unrelated roots
   429	            continue
   430	    require(inside,
   431	            f"candidate must resolve inside {cand_root} (got {path} -> {resolved})")
   432	    for t in _ADOPTED_TOKENS:
   433	        require(t not in path, f"refusing candidate onto adopted/protected path (token {t!r})")
   434	    return True

   437	def prove_identity(A, B, rtol, label):
   438	    """Fail-closed max-relative-difference identity gate (no subtraction hidden)."""
   439	    A = np.asarray(A, dtype=float); B = np.asarray(B, dtype=float)
   440	    require(A.shape == B.shape, f"{label}: shape {A.shape} != {B.shape}")
   441	    denom = max(1e-300, float(np.max(np.abs(A))))
   442	    err = float(np.max(np.abs(A - B)) / denom)
   443	    require(err <= rtol, f"{label}: identity broken (rel {err:.2e} > {rtol:.0e})")
   444	    return err

   447	def edges_bin_volume_hash(edges):
   448	    """Hash the ordered 5-axis edge arrays + the C-order per-bin volume vector."""
   449	    import numpy as _np
   450	    parts = []
   451	    for e in edges:
   452	        a = _np.asarray(e, dtype=float); require(a.ndim == 1 and a.size >= 2, "bad edge array")
   453	        parts.append(a.tobytes())
   454	    edge_hash = hashlib.sha256(b"|".join(parts)).hexdigest()
   455	    widths = [(_np.asarray(e, float)[1:] - _np.asarray(e, float)[:-1]) for e in edges]
   456	    vol = widths[0]
   457	    for w in widths[1:]:
   458	        vol = _np.multiply.outer(vol, w).ravel()   # C-order product of bin widths
   459	    vol_hash = hashlib.sha256(vol.astype(float).tobytes() + b"|C").hexdigest()
   460	    return {"edge_hash": edge_hash, "bin_volume_hash": vol_hash, "n_bins": int(vol.size)}

   463	def validate_orchestrator_merged_receipt(recdir, live_stat):
   464	    """Consume the owner-neutral merged-hash receipt: require COMPLETE + the four
   465	    files, recompute live size/integer-mtime vs the inventory, and return the
   466	    committed hash-list digest bound into our manifest. live_stat: dict path->(size,mtime)."""
   467	    import os as _os
   468	    for f in ("COMPLETE", "summary.tsv", "validation.tsv", "standard.sha256", "standard.inventory.tsv"):
   469	        require(_os.path.exists(_os.path.join(recdir, f)), f"orchestrator receipt missing {f}")
   470	    sha_lines = [l for l in open(_os.path.join(recdir, "standard.sha256")).read().splitlines() if l.strip()]
   471	    require(len(sha_lines) == N_ENDPOINTS, f"receipt standard.sha256 has {len(sha_lines)} != 10 lines")
   472	    merged = {}
   473	    for l in sha_lines:
   474	        h, p = l.split(None, 1); merged[p.strip()] = h
   475	    # recompute live size + integer mtime against the committed inventory
   476	    inv = {}
   477	    for l in open(_os.path.join(recdir, "standard.inventory.tsv")).read().splitlines():
   478	        if not l.strip() or l.startswith("#"):
   479	            continue
   480	        cols = l.split("\t")
   481	        if len(cols) >= 3:                       # orchestrator format: size<TAB>mtime<TAB>path
   482	            inv[cols[2]] = (int(cols[0]), int(float(cols[1])))
   483	    for p, (sz, mt) in inv.items():
   484	        require(p in live_stat, f"inventory path not live: {p}")
   485	        lsz, lmt = live_stat[p]
   486	        require(lsz == sz and int(lmt) == mt, f"live size/mtime drift for {p}")
   487	    digest = hashlib.sha256("\n".join(sorted(f"{merged[p]}  {p}" for p in merged)).encode()).hexdigest()
   488	    return {"merged_sha256": merged, "hash_list_digest": digest, "n": len(merged)}

   512	# The standard-P4 review surface: what a verifier verdict is understood to have reviewed when
   513	# it does not declare its own scope. Used by the token gate to prove that the files the verdict
   514	# covered have not changed between the reviewed commit and HEAD.
   515	# REPAIR-7 item 2. This was drawn by FILENAME PREFIX, which is a proxy, and it omitted every
   516	# module the chain actually executes -- uq_math, project_cov_nd, unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned,
   517	# xsec_nd, omnifold. A verdict could therefore authorize materially changed execution code.

   519	# graph rather than curated, and a test asserts the previously-missing modules are in it.

   520	STANDARD_P4_SURFACE_GLOBS = (
   521	    "nd-unfolding/p4_*.py",
   522	    "nd-unfolding/run_p4_*.sh",
   523	    "nd-unfolding/tests/test_p4_*.py",

   535	# Where first-party imports may resolve. Anything outside these is a third-party dependency and

   540	def standard_p4_execution_surface(entrypoints=None, max_depth=6):
   541	    """Every tracked first-party module reachable from the chain's entrypoints, by IMPORT.
   542	
   543	    Derived, not curated: the previous surface was a filename-prefix glob and silently omitted
   544	    the modules that do the work. Falls back to the glob surface if git is unavailable, and the
   545	    caller must treat an empty result as a refusal rather than an empty scope."""
   546	    import ast
   547	    tracked = set()
   548	    try:
   549	        tracked = set(subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files"], cwd=REPO_ROOT,
   550	                                              text=True).splitlines())
   551	    except Exception:
   552	        return sorted(tracked_files_matching(STANDARD_P4_SURFACE_GLOBS))
   553	
   554	    def resolve(mod):
   555	        for d in _IMPORT_SEARCH_DIRS:
   556	            cand = f"{d}/{mod.replace('.', '/')}.py".lstrip("./")
   557	            if cand in tracked:
   558	                return cand
   559	        return None
   560	
   561	    seen, frontier = set(), list(entrypoints or STANDARD_P4_ENTRYPOINTS)
   562	    for _ in range(max_depth):
   563	        nxt = []
   564	        for rel in frontier:
   565	            if rel in seen or rel not in tracked:
   566	                continue
   567	            seen.add(rel)
   568	            try:
   569	                tree = ast.parse((REPO_ROOT_PATH / rel).read_text(errors="replace"))
   570	            except Exception:
   571	                continue
   572	            for node in ast.walk(tree):
   573	                names = []
   574	                if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
   575	                    names = [a.name for a in node.names]
   576	                elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module and node.level == 0:
   577	                    names = [node.module]
   578	                for n in names:
   579	                    r = resolve(n)
   580	                    if r and r not in seen:
   581	                        nxt.append(r)
   582	        if not nxt:
   583	            break
   584	        frontier = nxt
   585	    # the shell drivers are executed, not imported, so add them explicitly
   586	    seen.update(p for p in tracked if p.startswith("nd-unfolding/run_p4_") and p.endswith(".sh"))
   587	    return sorted(seen)
   588	
   589	
   590	def tracked_files_matching(globs, rev="HEAD"):
   591	    """Tracked paths at `rev` matching any glob. Sorted, so the result is order-stable."""
   592	    out = set()
   593	    for g in globs:
   594	        try:
   595	            r = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev],
   596	                                        cwd=REPO_ROOT, text=True,
   597	                                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).splitlines()
   598	        except Exception:
   599	            return []
   600	        import fnmatch
   601	        out.update(p for p in r if fnmatch.fnmatch(p, g))
   602	    return sorted(out)
   603	
   604	
   605	def paths_unchanged_between(rev_a, rev_b, paths):
   606	    """Every path in `paths` has the same blob at rev_a and rev_b.
   607	
   608	    Returns (ok, [differing paths]). Fails CLOSED: if git cannot answer for a path, that path
   609	    counts as differing, because an unverifiable claim is not a satisfied one."""
   610	    differing = []
   611	    for p in paths:
   612	        try:
   613	            a = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"{rev_a}:{p}"], cwd=REPO_ROOT,
   614	                                        text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   615	        except Exception:
   616	            a = None
   617	        try:
   618	            b = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"{rev_b}:{p}"], cwd=REPO_ROOT,
   619	                                        text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   620	        except Exception:
   621	            b = None
   622	        if a is None or b is None or a != b:
   623	            differing.append(p)
   624	    return (not differing), differing
   625

   627	def code_rev_in_history(rev, head=None):
   628	    """True iff `rev` is reachable from HEAD in this repository (ancestor of, or equal to).
   629	
   630	    Deliberately reachability rather than equality -- see the note in validate_endpoint_receipt.
   631	    Fails CLOSED: if git cannot answer, the answer is False, because an unverifiable provenance
   632	    claim is not a satisfied one."""
   633	    if not isinstance(rev, str) or not rev.strip():
   634	        return False
   635	    try:
   636	        subprocess.check_call(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", rev.strip(), head or "HEAD"],
   637	                              cwd=REPO_ROOT, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
   638	        return True
   639	    except Exception:
   640	        return False

   643	def validate_endpoint_receipt(rec, *, tag, root_sha256, merged_sha256,
   644	                              central5d_sha256, config_hash, bkg_mode,
   645	                              code_rev, unfold_blob):
   646	    """Fail closed unless the receipt is complete AND every recorded identity matches the
   647	    live/committed one. Returns True, or raises P4GateError naming the first mismatch.
   648	
   649	    REPAIR-5 (defect 2). The previous version required `code_rev` to be a NON-EMPTY STRING and
   650	    compared it to nothing, and the receipt recorded no source identity at all -- so an
   651	    endpoint produced under a changed unfold driver was still skipped. That is the third
   652	    instance in this chain of "assert presence, never compare": the first is the
   653	    `P4_VERIFIER_PASS` non-emptiness gate (KNOWN_ISSUES #21), the second is the `identities`
   654	    block whose members were literal `True`. Presence is not evidence; both `code_rev` and the
   655	    producing driver's committed blob are now COMPARED."""
   656	    require(isinstance(rec, dict) and rec, f"receipt for {tag} is not a JSON object")
   657	    missing = [k for k in RECEIPT_REQUIRED_KEYS if k not in rec]
   658	    require(not missing, f"receipt {tag} missing required keys {missing} (incomplete legacy format)")
   659	    require(rec["mode"] in RECEIPT_MODES, f"receipt {tag} unknown mode {rec['mode']!r}")
   660	    require(rec["tag"] == tag, f"receipt tag {rec['tag']!r} != {tag!r} (receipt/ROOT pair mismatch)")
   661	    require(rec["root_sha256"] == root_sha256,
   662	            f"receipt {tag} root_sha256 drift: recorded {rec['root_sha256']} vs live {root_sha256}")
   663	    require(rec["merged_sha256"] == merged_sha256,
   664	            f"receipt {tag} merged_sha256 drift vs the orchestrator receipt")
   665	    require(rec["central5d_sha256"] == central5d_sha256,
   666	            f"receipt {tag} central5d_sha256 drift (the central moved under this endpoint)")
   667	    require(rec["config_hash"] == config_hash,
   668	            f"receipt {tag} config_hash drift: produced under a different unfold configuration")
   669	    require(rec["bkg_mode"] == bkg_mode,
   670	            f"receipt {tag} bkg_mode {rec['bkg_mode']!r} != declared {bkg_mode!r}")
   671	    # D2: compared, not merely present.
   672	    require(isinstance(rec["code_rev"], str) and rec["code_rev"],
   673	            f"receipt {tag} has no code_rev")
   674	    require(isinstance(code_rev, str) and code_rev,
   675	            f"cannot validate receipt {tag}: no live code_rev to compare against")
   676	    # REPAIR-6b. This used to require code_rev == HEAD, and that was WRONG in the same way
   677	    # KNOWN_ISSUES #24 describes: it broke on correct behaviour. Any commit anywhere in the repo
   678	    # -- including another lane's, touching nothing this chain reads -- expired all ten receipts
   679	    # while the code that produced them was byte-identical. Caught by the self-check on the first
   680	    # production run: the PET lane advanced main by 8 commits mid-run, HEAD moved
   681	    # 42268b6 -> 203ff01, `git diff` on the unfold driver was EMPTY, and the gate rejected all ten.
   682	    #
   683	    # The producing-code binding is `unfold_blob`, which IS strictly compared below. `code_rev` is
   684	    # repository context, so the honest check is REACHABILITY, not equality: the receipt must come
   685	    # from this history. That still catches a receipt carried in from a foreign branch or a
   686	    # rewritten history, and does not expire on unrelated work.
   687	    require(code_rev_in_history(rec["code_rev"]),
   688	            f"receipt {tag} code_rev {rec['code_rev']} is not an ancestor of HEAD ({code_rev}): "
   689	            f"this receipt did not come from this repository's history")
   690	    require(isinstance(unfold_blob, str) and unfold_blob,
   691	            f"cannot validate receipt {tag}: no committed unfold-driver blob to compare against")
   692	    require(rec[RECEIPT_SOURCE_KEY] == unfold_blob,
   693	            f"receipt {tag} unfold_blob {rec[RECEIPT_SOURCE_KEY]} != committed {unfold_blob}: the "
   694	            f"unfold driver changed since this endpoint was produced")
   695	    return True
   696

   698	def cmask_order_hash_4d(mask):
   699	    """4D reported-mask + C-order fingerprint (repair-4, defect 5c).
   700	
   701	    `mask_order_hash` fails closed on GRID_NBINS, which is the 5D grid, so the 4D mask had no
   702	    hash helper and the projector compared only the reported COUNT. A count is not an ordering:
   703	    a permuted 4D mask with the same population passed. Same construction as the 5D helper --
   704	    C-order indices of the selected bins -- so the two are comparable by eye in a manifest.
   705	    Deliberately NOT size-pinned: the 4D grid is a marginal of the 5D one and the standard lane
   706	    has no pinned canonical 4D target (see RUNBOOK-20260807 §7.4)."""
   707	    idx = np.nonzero(np.asarray(mask))[0].astype(np.int64)
   708	    require(idx.size > 0, "4D reported mask is empty")
   709	    return hashlib.sha256(idx.tobytes() + b"|C").hexdigest()
   710

   712	def matrix_content_hash(M):
   713	    """Deterministic digest of a matrix's CONTENTS (repair-4, defect 5d).
   714	
   715	    The projection receipt recorded only `M_shape`, which two different projectors of the same
   716	    dimensions share. Hashes C-contiguous float64 bytes plus the shape, so a changed weight is
   717	    caught and a transposed/reshaped M cannot collide with the original."""
   718	    A = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(M, dtype=np.float64))
   719	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   720	    h.update(repr(A.shape).encode()); h.update(b"|C|f8|"); h.update(A.tobytes())
   721	    return h.hexdigest()
   722	
   723	
   724	def check_full_total_identity(Ccomb, Csyst, Cstat, Cml, rtol=1e-9):
   725	    """PROVE C_combined = C_syst + C_stat + C_ML by comparing the residual to the actual
   726	    stat and ML blocks. Returns the measured max-relative error.
   727	
   728	    REPAIR-5 (defect 4b / 6). Repair-4 checked only that `C_combined - C_syst` was symmetric
   729	    PSD and called that the full-total identity, in a gate name, a receipt field and a test
   730	    name. PSD is NECESSARY but nowhere near SUFFICIENT: every covariance-shaped residual passes
   731	    it, including one built from the wrong stat block, a doubled ML block, or a residual that
   732	    simply is not stat+ML at all. Naming a weak check after a strong claim is the same
   733	    "strong name over weak check" pattern as the test that passed because argparse rejected an
   734	    argument before the guard it named ever ran (verifier defect 6b). This compares."""
   735	    resid = np.asarray(Ccomb, float) - np.asarray(Csyst, float)
   736	    expect = np.asarray(Cstat, float) + np.asarray(Cml, float)
   737	    require(resid.shape == expect.shape,
   738	            f"full-total identity: residual {resid.shape} != stat+ML {expect.shape}")
   739	    # PSD of the residual is retained as a SEPARATE, weaker sanity check -- not as the identity.
   740	    check_symmetric_psd(resid)
   741	    return prove_identity(resid, expect, rtol, "C_combined - C_syst == C_stat + C_ML")
   742

   744	def check_declared_migration_policy(policy, census_abs, band, nonzero_bands, zero_bands):
   745	    """Compare the DECLARED migration policy against the OBSERVED census.
   746	
   747	    REPAIR-5 (pattern sweep). `check_merged_metadata` required `migration_policy` to be
   748	    truthy and compared it to nothing -- a declared policy no consumer ever checked, which is
   749	    the same presence-not-comparison pattern as defect 2's `code_rev`. A merged file could
   750	    declare any policy string, or the wrong one, and pass."""
   751	    require(isinstance(policy, str) and policy.strip(), "declared migration policy missing")
   752	    require(band in nonzero_bands or band in zero_bands,
   753	            f"band {band} is in neither the nonzero- nor the zero-migration set")
   754	    n = int(census_abs)
   755	    if band in nonzero_bands:
   756	        require(n > 0, f"{band} declares selection-complete migration but census is {n}")
   757	        require("selection" in policy.lower(),
   758	                f"{band} migrates ({n}) but declares policy {policy!r}, which does not claim "
   759	                f"selection completeness")
   760	    else:
   761	        require(n == 0, f"{band} is declared bin-migration-only but census is {n}")
   762	        # REPAIR-6: the zero side never validated the policy TEXT, so a band could migrate zero
   763	        # events while declaring a selection-complete policy and pass.
   764	        require("selection" not in policy.lower() or "only" in policy.lower(),
   765	                f"{band} has zero selection migration but declares policy {policy!r}, which "
   766	                f"claims selection completeness")
   767	    return True

   770	def require_exact_endpoint_tags(tags):
   771	    """Reject BOTH missing and EXTRA tags. The old inventory only looked for the ten expected
   772	    names, so an eleventh product in the directory was invisible to it."""
   773	    got, want = set(tags), {f"{b}_{e}" for b in BANDS for e in ENDPOINTS}
   774	    require(not (want - got), f"missing endpoint tags: {sorted(want - got)}")
   775	    require(not (got - want), f"unexpected extra endpoint tags: {sorted(got - want)}")
   776	    return True

   779	def sha256_file(path, _bufsz=1 << 20):
   780	    """Durable file digest (login-computable; no ROOT)."""
   781	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   782	    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
   783	        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(_bufsz), b""):
   784	            h.update(chunk)
   785	    return h.hexdigest()

   788	def canonical_endpoints():
   789	    """The exact 10 (band, endpoint) logical tasks, in fixed order."""
   790	    return [(b, ep) for b in BANDS for ep in ENDPOINTS]

   793	def endpoint_manifest_hash(entries):
   794	    """entries: iterable of (band, endpoint, fingerprint). Hash is order-independent
   795	    over the SET but requires the exact 10-endpoint inventory (fail-closed)."""
   796	    seen = {}
   797	    for band, ep, fp in entries:
   798	        require(band in BANDS, f"unknown band {band!r}")
   799	        require(ep in ENDPOINTS, f"bad endpoint {ep!r}")
   800	        seen[(band, int(ep))] = str(fp)
   801	    require(len(seen) == N_ENDPOINTS,
   802	            f"expected exactly {N_ENDPOINTS} endpoints, got {len(seen)} "
   803	            f"(missing {sorted(set(canonical_endpoints())-set(seen))})")
   804	    blob = json.dumps({f"{b}_{e}": seen[(b, e)] for (b, e) in canonical_endpoints()},
   805	                      sort_keys=True)
   806	    return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest()

   809	def mask_order_hash(mask):
   810	    """Hash of the reported-bin mask + C-order. mask: 1-D bool/int array over the
   811	    full grid. Pins which bins are reported and their order so a projection or a
   812	    component sum can never silently mix masks."""
   813	    m = np.asarray(mask)
   814	    require(m.ndim == 1, "mask must be 1-D (C-order ravel over the 5D grid)")
   815	    require(m.size == GRID_NBINS, f"mask size {m.size} != grid {GRID_NBINS}")
   816	    idx = np.nonzero(m.astype(bool))[0].astype(np.int64)
   817	    require(idx.size > 0, "mask selects zero reported bins")
   818	    return hashlib.sha256(idx.tobytes() + b"|C").hexdigest(), int(idx.size)
   819

   822	def require_complete_unfold_set(present_tags):
   823	    """present_tags: iterable of '<band>_<ep>' that passed CONTENT validation.
   824	    Fail-closed unless all 10 canonical endpoints are present+valid."""
   825	    present = set(present_tags)
   826	    need = {f"{b}_{e}" for (b, e) in canonical_endpoints()}
   827	    missing = sorted(need - present)
   828	    require(not missing, f"incomplete unfold set: missing/invalid {missing}")
   829	    require(present == need, f"unexpected unfold tags: {sorted(present - need)}")
   830	    return True

    69	def cmask_hash(vec):
    70	    idx = np.nonzero(np.asarray(vec) > 0)[0].astype(np.int64)
    71	    return hashlib.sha256(idx.tobytes() + b"|C").hexdigest(), int(idx.size)

   249	# ---- source provenance: git blobs of code + binary digest + per-file source commits ----
   250	import subprocess
   251	# REPAIR-4 (verifier defect 3b/3c, and KNOWN_ISSUES #23). These used to hash the WORKING TREE
   252	# (`git hash-object <path>`), so the manifest recorded whatever happened to be checked out --
   253	# which is how an unrelated dirty OmniFold blob was absorbed in 2026-07, and how re-running
   254	# evidence in 2026-08 silently re-attributed 07-18 endpoints to a newer driver and binary.
   255	# Now: hash the COMMITTED object at HEAD, record the commit that introduced that exact blob,
   256	# and fail closed if the working tree differs from HEAD for any bound path -- because a
   257	# provenance record that can disagree with what actually ran is worse than none.
   258	def _committed_blob(rel):
   259	    """The blob sha of `rel` as committed at HEAD (not the working-tree copy)."""
   260	    try:
   261	        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"HEAD:{rel}"],
   262	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   263	    except Exception:
   264	        return None
   265	def _worktree_blob(rel):
   266	    try:
   267	        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "hash-object", rel],
   268	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   269	    except Exception:
   270	        return None
   271	def _blob_introducing_commit(rel, blob):
   272	    """The most recent commit whose version of `rel` IS `blob`. The old code recorded
   273	    `git log -1 -- <rel>`, i.e. the last commit to touch the path, which need not be the commit
   274	    that introduced the blob it recorded beside it."""
   275	    if not blob:
   276	        return None
   277	    try:
   278	        revs = subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "--format=%H", "--", rel],
   279	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).split()
   280	        for r in revs:
   281	            try:
   282	                b = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"{r}:{rel}"],
   283	                                            cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   284	            except Exception:
   285	                continue
   286	            if b == blob:
   287	                return r
   288	    except Exception:
   289	        pass
   290	    return None

   292	       "omnifold": "unbinned_unfolding/python/omnifold.py",

   294	       "launcher": "nd-unfolding/sbatch_evloop_array_5d_active_laterals.sh",
   295	       "evidence_generator": "nd-unfolding/p4_evidence.py",
   296	       "builder": "nd-unfolding/p4_build_components.py"}

   298	man["source_commits"] = {k: _blob_introducing_commit(v, man["source_blobs"][k])
   299	                         for k, v in SRC.items()}
   300	# D3b: refuse to record a committed blob while a DIFFERENT version is what would actually run.
   301	# REPAIR-5 (defect 3): the previous guard read `need(_w is None or _c == _w, ...)`, which is
   302	# FAIL-OPEN -- `_worktree_blob` returns None when `git hash-object` fails, i.e. when the bound
   303	# source has been DELETED, so deleting a file passed the dirty check instead of blocking it.
   304	# The None case is now a blocker, and "absent from the working tree" is distinguished from
   305	# "git could not be run", because those need different fixes.

   308	    _abs = os.path.join(REPO, _rel)

   310	    if not os.path.exists(_abs):
   311	        blockers.append(f"source {_k} ({_rel}) is committed but ABSENT from the working tree; "
   312	                        f"evidence cannot claim a blob for a file that is not there")
   313	    else:
   314	        _w = _worktree_blob(_rel)
   315	        need(_w is not None,
   316	             f"source {_k} ({_rel}) exists but `git hash-object` failed; cannot prove the working "
   317	             f"tree matches the committed blob (is git available in this environment?)")
   318	        # NOTE the missing `_w is None or` disjunct: that is what made this fail-OPEN, and it is
   319	        # deliberately gone. `need` does not short-circuit, so an unresolvable _w reaches here as
   320	        # `_c == None` -> False -> blocker, which is the correct direction.
   321	        need(_c == _w,
   322	             f"source {_k} ({_rel}) is DIRTY: working tree {_w} != committed {_c}. Commit or revert "
   323	             f"before generating evidence -- a manifest that records the committed blob while a "
   324	             f"different file runs is the 2026-07 dirty-OmniFold absorption (defect 3b).")
   325	    need(man["source_commits"][_k] is not None,
   326	         f"source {_k} ({_rel}): cannot find the commit that introduced its recorded blob")

   410	# under their consumable names -- an incomplete fix of my own, caught because a blocked run left

   412	# none are.

   415	json.dump({"merged": maudit}, open(f"{EVID}/p4_merged_audit{_sfx}.json", "w"), indent=2)
   416

   418	# need(/require( on verifier_crosscheck returned zero. All five could read DIFF and this stage
   419	# still exited 0 with EVIDENCE-COMPLETE. They are the independently-observed bindings the whole
   420	# evidence stage exists to confirm, so printing them was the entire check. Found by the
   421	# mechanical sweep (REPAIR6-RECORDED-NOT-CHECKED-INVENTORY.md §A), on nobody's prior list.
   422	for _k, _v in man["verifier_crosscheck"].items():
   423	    need(_v, f"verifier cross-check {_k} is DIFF: recomputed binding disagrees with the "
   424	             f"independently observed value. This is the check the evidence stage exists to "
   425	             f"perform; it may not be reported and passed over.")
   426	
   427	print("=== recomputed vs observed ===")

   429	    print(f"  {k}: {'MATCH' if v else 'DIFF'}")
   430	print(f"mask5d n={man['mask5d_nreported']} mask4d n={man['mask4d_nreported']}")
   431	_ok = sum(1 for v in repro.values() if "error" not in v)
   432	print(f"endpoint reproduction vs reference: {_ok}/{len(repro)} within tolerance "
   433	      f"(per-bin {P.REPRO_RTOL_PER_BIN:.0e}, integral {P.REPRO_RTOL_INTEGRAL:.0e})")
   434	if repro:
   435	    _wb = max((v.get("max_rel_bin", 0) for v in repro.values()), default=0)
   436	    _wi = max((v.get("rel_integral", 0) for v in repro.values()), default=0)
   437	    print(f"  worst per-bin {_wb:.2e}   worst integral {_wi:.2e}")
   438	print(f"footing: bkg_mode={man['footing']['bkg_mode']} estimator={man['footing']['estimator']} "
   439	      f"seed={man['footing']['seed']} iters={man['footing']['iters']}")

   441	      {t: man["footing_evidence"][t]["log_bkg_mode"] for t in sorted(man["footing_evidence"])})
   442	print("selection migration:", {t: maudit[t]["selection_migration_abs"] for t in maudit if "selection_migration_abs" in maudit[t]})
   443	if blockers:
   444	    print("EVIDENCE-BLOCKED:", "; ".join(blockers[:10]))
   445	    sys.exit(2)
   446	print("EVIDENCE-COMPLETE: all required fields proven; receipts in", EVID)

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Bind P4_VERIFIER_PASS to a real verifier verdict (closes KNOWN_ISSUES #21 / inventory A1).
     3	
     4	The gate at `run_p4_standard.sh:41` tested only `[[ -z "${P4_VERIFIER_PASS}" ]]`, so ANY
     5	non-empty string authorized covariance construction, and the refusal message named the variable
     6	to set. It was demonstrated load-bearing on 2026-08-07: an autonomous run that self-authorized
     7	would have written a candidate ROOT at stage 4 and died at stage 5, because stages 4-6 had never
     8	executed and were broken three independent ways.
     9	
    10	**The fix is deliberately not "check the variable harder."** An agent that can set an env var
    11	can also write a JSON file, so a token bound to a file the agent could create is no gate at all.
    12	The token must resolve to a verdict that is:
    13	
    14	  1. a file whose sha256 EQUALS the token                     (the token is not a password,
    15	                                                               it is the digest of the evidence)
    16	  2. TRACKED in git and identical to its committed blob        (so it cannot be fabricated in the
    17	                                                               working tree, and reviewing it is
    18	                                                               reviewing what authorized the run)
    19	  3. `verdict == "PASS"`                                       (BLOCK/absent authorizes nothing)
    20	  4a. `code_rev` is an ANCESTOR of HEAD                        (the verdict came from this
    21	                                                               history, not a foreign branch)
    22	  4b. every file the verdict REVIEWED is byte-identical        (a PASS cannot authorize code the
    23	      between that commit and HEAD                              verifier never saw)
    24	
    25	Rule 4 was originally `code_rev == HEAD`, which broke on correct behaviour: any push by another
    26	lane between the PASS and stages 4-6 invalidated a good verdict over commits touching nothing
    27	reviewed. 4a+4b is strictly stronger -- it checks what the rule protects instead of a proxy that
    28	unrelated commits perturb. Scope comes from the verdict's `review_scope` if declared, else the
    29	whole standard-P4 surface, which is the wider and safer default.
    30	
    31	That still does not make forgery impossible -- someone can commit a fake verdict -- but it moves
    32	the act from "set a variable nobody will ever see" to "commit a falsified receipt into the
    33	ledger under your own name," which is the difference between an accident and a decision.
    34	
    35	Usage:  p4_check_verifier_token.py --token <sha256>
    36	Exit 0 and print the resolved receipt path, or print TOKEN-REJECT :: <reason> and exit 1.
    37	"""
    38	import argparse, glob, json, os, subprocess, sys
    39	
    40	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    41	import p4_lib as P
    42	
    43	RECEIPT_DIR = os.path.join(P.REPO_ROOT, "docs", "orchestration", "runs", "standard-p4-verifier")
    44	
    45	
    46	def _git(*args):
    47	    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=P.REPO_ROOT, text=True,
    48	                                   stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
    49	
    50	
    51	def resolve(token):
    52	    if not token or not token.strip():
    53	        raise P.P4GateError("empty token")
    54	    token = token.strip().lower()
    55	    if len(token) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in token):
    56	        raise P.P4GateError(
    57	            f"token is not a sha256 ({len(token)} chars). The token must be the digest of a "
    58	            f"committed standard-p4-verifier verdict, not a passphrase.")
    59	    if not os.path.isdir(RECEIPT_DIR):
    60	        raise P.P4GateError(f"no verifier receipt directory at {RECEIPT_DIR}")
    61	
    62	    head = _git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    63	    matches = []
    64	    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(RECEIPT_DIR, "*.json"))):
    65	        if P.sha256_file(p) == token:
    66	            matches.append(p)
    67	    if not matches:
    68	        raise P.P4GateError(
    69	            f"no verdict in {os.path.relpath(RECEIPT_DIR, P.REPO_ROOT)} has sha256 {token[:16]}… "
    70	            f"-- the token must be the digest of an actual receipt")
    71	    if len(matches) > 1:
    72	        raise P.P4GateError(f"token matches {len(matches)} receipts; ambiguous")
    73	    path = matches[0]
    74	    rel = os.path.relpath(path, P.REPO_ROOT)
    75	
    76	    # (2) tracked AND unmodified -- a receipt invented in the working tree must not authorize
    77	    try:
    78	        _git("ls-files", "--error-unmatch", rel)
    79	    except Exception:
    80	        raise P.P4GateError(f"{rel} is not tracked in git; an untracked verdict authorizes nothing")
    81	    committed = _git("rev-parse", f"HEAD:{rel}")
    82	    worktree = _git("hash-object", rel)
    83	    if committed != worktree:
    84	        raise P.P4GateError(
    85	            f"{rel} differs from its committed blob (working {worktree[:12]} vs committed "
    86	            f"{committed[:12]}); the authorizing verdict must be the reviewed one")
    87	
    88	    v = json.load(open(path))
    89	    # (3) verdict
    90	    if str(v.get("verdict", "")).upper() != "PASS":
    91	        raise P.P4GateError(
    92	            f"{rel} records verdict={v.get('verdict')!r}, not PASS -- this authorizes nothing")
    93	    # (4) REPAIR-6c. This required `code_rev == HEAD` and was wrong for the same reason the
    94	    # receipt gate was: it breaks on CORRECT behaviour. Another lane pushing between the verifier
    95	    # PASS and stages 4-6 -- which happened today, eight commits mid-run -- would reject a valid
    96	    # verdict over commits touching nothing the verifier reviewed.
    97	    #
    98	    # Replaced by a pair that is STRICTLY STRONGER than equality, because it checks the thing the
    99	    # rule protects rather than a proxy unrelated commits perturb:
   100	    #   (4a) the reviewed commit must be an ANCESTOR of HEAD -- catches a verdict carried in from
   101	    #        a foreign branch or a rewritten history;
   102	    #   (4b) every file the verdict actually REVIEWED must be byte-identical between that commit
   103	    #        and HEAD -- so a PASS cannot authorize code the verifier never saw.
   104	    # The verdict may declare its own scope in `review_scope`; absent that, the fallback is every
   105	    # tracked file on the standard-P4 surface, the wider and therefore safer assumption.
   106	    cr = v.get("code_rev")
   107	    if not cr:
   108	        raise P.P4GateError(f"{rel} records no code_rev; cannot tell which patch it passed")
   109	    cr = str(cr).strip()
   110	    if not P.code_rev_in_history(cr):
   111	        raise P.P4GateError(
   112	            f"{rel} passed code_rev {cr[:12]}, which is not an ancestor of HEAD ({head[:12]}). "
   113	            f"That verdict did not come from this repository's history.")
   114	
   115	    scope = v.get("review_scope")
   116	    if isinstance(scope, list) and scope:
   117	        paths, scope_src = sorted(str(x) for x in scope), "declared review_scope"
   118	    else:
   119	        # REPAIR-7 item 2: derived from the IMPORT GRAPH, not a filename glob. The glob omitted
   120	        # uq_math, project_cov_nd, unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned, xsec_nd and omnifold -- i.e. the
   121	        # code that actually runs -- so a verdict could authorize materially changed execution.
   122	        paths = P.standard_p4_execution_surface()
   123	        scope_src = "default standard-P4 EXECUTION surface (%d tracked modules)" % len(paths)
   124	    if not paths:
   125	        raise P.P4GateError("could not resolve a review scope; refusing to authorize blind")
   126	    ok, differing = P.paths_unchanged_between(cr, head, paths)
   127	    if not ok:
   128	        raise P.P4GateError(
   129	            f"{rel} reviewed {cr[:12]}, but {len(differing)} file(s) it covered have CHANGED at "
   130	            f"HEAD ({head[:12]}): {', '.join(differing[:4])}"
   131	            f"{' ...' if len(differing) > 4 else ''}. A PASS cannot authorize code the verifier "
   132	            f"never saw; re-run the verifier.")
   133	    v["_resolved_review_scope"] = scope_src
   134	    if v.get("authorizes_covariance_stages_4_6") is False:
   135	        raise P.P4GateError(f"{rel} explicitly sets authorizes_covariance_stages_4_6=false")
   136	    return rel, v
   137	
   138	
   139	def main():
   140	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   141	    ap.add_argument("--token", required=True)
   142	    a = ap.parse_args()
   143	    try:
   144	        rel, v = resolve(a.token)
   145	    except P.P4GateError as e:
   146	        print(f"TOKEN-REJECT :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   147	    except Exception as e:
   148	        print(f"TOKEN-REJECT :: unexpected {type(e).__name__}: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   149	    print(f"TOKEN-OK :: {rel} (verdict=PASS, code_rev={v.get('code_rev')})")
   150	    sys.exit(0)
   151	
   152	
   153	if __name__ == "__main__":
   154	    main()
     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Endpoint-receipt gate for run_p4_unfold_std.sh's resume path (repair-4, verifier defect 2).
     3	
     4	Exit 0 iff the receipt is complete and every recorded identity matches the live/committed one;
     5	otherwise print `RECEIPT-REJECT :: <reason>` and exit 1, which makes the launcher re-run the
     6	endpoint transactionally instead of skipping it.
     7	
     8	Deliberately a separate CLI rather than inline `python3 -c` in the launcher: the previous skip
     9	logic was an unreadable one-liner, and a gate that cannot be unit-tested is the defect this
    10	whole repair round exists to remove. ROOT-free -- content validity of the ROOT itself is the
    11	launcher's `valid_root`, this is the provenance half.
    12	
    13	Usage:
    14	  p4_check_receipt.py --receipt R.done --tag BAND_EP --root OUT.root --merged MERGED.root
    15	"""
    16	import argparse, json, os, sys
    17	
    18	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    19	import p4_lib as P
    20	
    21	REPO = P.REPO_ROOT
    22	ND = P.ND_ROOT
    23	CEN5 = f"{ND}/products/5d/xsec_5d_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm.root"
    24	RECDIR = f"{REPO}/docs/orchestration/state/merged-input-hashes/p4-merged-20260718"
    25	UNFOLD_SRC = "nd-unfolding/unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.py"
    26	
    27	
    28	def committed_unfold_blob():
    29	    """The unfold driver's blob AS COMMITTED at HEAD (repair-5, defect 2).
    30	
    31	    The receipt gate previously required `code_rev` to be a non-empty string and compared it to
    32	    nothing, and recorded no source identity at all -- so an endpoint produced under a changed
    33	    driver was still skipped. Both are now compared, and this is the value they compare against.
    34	    Fails closed (returns None -> caller rejects) rather than guessing."""
    35	    import subprocess
    36	    try:
    37	        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"HEAD:{UNFOLD_SRC}"],
    38	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
    39	    except Exception:
    40	        return None
    41	
    42	
    43	def current_code_rev():
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    try:
    46	        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    47	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
    48	    except Exception:
    49	        return None
    50	
    51	
    52	def committed_merged_sha(merged_path):
    53	    """The orchestrator receipt's committed hash for this merged file, after its own live
    54	    size+integer-mtime check. Never re-hashes 53.8 GB."""
    55	    live = {}
    56	    for b in P.BANDS:
    57	        for ep in P.ENDPOINTS:
    58	            rel = (f"nd-unfolding/active_universe_5d/standard/merged/"
    59	                   f"runEventLoopOmniFold_5D_MEFHC_active_{b}_{ep}.root")
    60	            ap = f"{REPO}/{rel}"
    61	            st = os.stat(ap)
    62	            live[rel] = (st.st_size, int(st.st_mtime))
    63	    rec = P.validate_orchestrator_merged_receipt(RECDIR, live)
    64	    base = os.path.basename(merged_path)
    65	    for p, h in rec["merged_sha256"].items():
    66	        if os.path.basename(p) == base:
    67	            return h
    68	    raise P.P4GateError(f"{base} not in the orchestrator merged receipt")
    69	
    70	
    71	def main():
    72	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    73	    ap.add_argument("--receipt", required=True)
    74	    ap.add_argument("--tag", required=True)
    75	    ap.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    76	    ap.add_argument("--merged", required=True)
    77	    a = ap.parse_args()
    78	    try:
    79	        if not os.path.exists(a.receipt) or os.path.getsize(a.receipt) == 0:
    80	            raise P.P4GateError("receipt absent or empty")
    81	        try:
    82	            rec = json.load(open(a.receipt))
    83	        except Exception as e:
    84	            raise P.P4GateError(f"receipt is not valid JSON ({e})")
    85	        cfg = P.P4Config(); cfg.validate()
    86	        blob, rev = committed_unfold_blob(), current_code_rev()
    87	        if not blob:
    88	            raise P.P4GateError(f"cannot resolve the committed blob of {UNFOLD_SRC}; refusing to "
    89	                                f"accept a receipt whose producing source cannot be checked")
    90	        if not rev:
    91	            raise P.P4GateError("cannot resolve HEAD; refusing to accept a receipt whose "
    92	                                "code_rev cannot be compared")
    93	        P.validate_endpoint_receipt(
    94	            rec, tag=a.tag,
    95	            root_sha256=P.sha256_file(a.root),
    96	            merged_sha256=committed_merged_sha(a.merged),
    97	            central5d_sha256=P.sha256_file(CEN5),
    98	            config_hash=cfg.hash(),
    99	            bkg_mode=cfg.bkg_mode,
   100	            code_rev=rev,
   101	            unfold_blob=blob)
   102	    except P.P4GateError as e:
   103	        print(f"RECEIPT-REJECT :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   104	    except Exception as e:                      # never let an unexpected error read as PASS
   105	        print(f"RECEIPT-REJECT :: unexpected {type(e).__name__}: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   106	    print(f"RECEIPT-OK :: {a.tag}")
   107	    sys.exit(0)
   108	
   109	
   110	if __name__ == "__main__":
   111	    main()
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# CANONICAL standard-only P4 driver (repair 2026-07-18) — the ONE authoritative,
     3	# manifest-bound, fail-closed command chain. Runs inside a compute alloc via
     4	# `srun --overlap --jobid=<holder>` (do NOT nest srun inside stages). STANDARD only;
     5	# FPS post-processing is Agent C's and is never invoked here.
     6	#
     7	# Ordered stages (each fail-closed; the chain aborts on any nonzero stage):
     8	#   1 audit          run_p4_merge_audit_std.sh            (10 hadd + per-playlist audit)
     9	#   2 unfold         run_p4_unfold_std.sh                 (atomic, resumable, --seed 42, no --universe)
    10	#   3 evidence       p4_evidence.py                       (recompute hashes + merged/endpoint receipts + manifest)
    11	#   --- HARD GATE: standard-p4-verifier must PASS on the committed patch before covariance ---
    12	#   4 components     p4_build_components.py               (manifest-bound; named bkgaware components + 5 active bands)
    13	#   5 validate       p4_validate_active_lateral.py        (candidate/support/manifest/merged-audit)
    14	#   6 project        p4_project_4d.py                     (5D->4D mask/edge hashes + central non-mutation)
    15	#
    16	# REPAIR-4, 2026-08-07 (verifier defect 1 of six; see
    17	# docs/orchestration/REPAIR4-DEFECT-STATUS-20260807.md). Stages 4-6 had NEVER EXECUTED --
    18	# STOP_AFTER defaulted to a pre-covariance stage, so nothing ever ran them and nothing
    19	# tested them. They were not a working path with typos; all three of the following were
    20	# independently wrong and fixing only the argument names would still have died on the key:
    21	#   (a) ORDER: evidence ran BEFORE unfold, so the manifest described endpoints that the very
    22	#       next stage could rewrite. Correct order is merge+audit -> unfold -> endpoint-evidence,
    23	#       which is now what runs. NOTE the resume/attest path in run_p4_unfold_std.sh reads the
    24	#       COMMITTED manifest from the previous round, which is what legacy attestation means --
    25	#       it is not a forward reference to the manifest this run is about to produce.
    26	#   (b) CLI: the validator was called with `--active`/`--merged-dir`; it requires
    27	#       `--candidate --support --manifest --merged-audit --out`. The projector was called with
    28	#       `--proj`, which it does not define.
    29	#   (c) KEY: both calls named `hCov_std_final5_candidate`, which NOTHING writes. The builder
    30	#       emits `hCov_stdcombined5d_total_candidate` (full total) and
    31	#       `hCov_stdsyst5d_total_candidate`; the projector takes the full total.
    32	#
    33	# RETIRED / FORBIDDEN for standard publication (unsafe, non-manifest-bound):
    34	#   merge_active_endpoints.sh, run_active_lateral_unfolds_interactive.sh  (guarded to abort)
    35	#
    36	# STOP_AFTER controls the last stage to run. DEFAULT IS 'audit' -- changed in repair-4 from
    37	# 'evidence', because reordering put `unfold` (which WRITES receipts) before evidence, and a
    38	# default that silently starts writing receipts is the opposite of a safe preflight. Valid:
    39	#   audit | unfold | evidence | components | validate | project
    40	# Covariance stages (4-6) run ONLY with a P4_VERIFIER_PASS token bound to a verifier receipt.
    41	set -o pipefail

    44	source "${REPO}/setup_salloc_env.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1
    45	cd "${ND}"
    46	STOP_AFTER="${STOP_AFTER:-audit}"
    47	case "${STOP_AFTER}" in
    48	  audit|unfold|evidence|components|validate|project) ;;
    49	  merge) echo "[p4-std] STOP_AFTER=merge renamed to 'audit' in repair-4 (stage 1 is merge+audit)"; STOP_AFTER=audit ;;
    50	  *) echo "[p4-std] ABORT unknown STOP_AFTER='${STOP_AFTER}' (audit|unfold|evidence|components|validate|project)"; exit 2 ;;
    51	esac
    52	SUPPORT_FAMILY="${SUPPORT_FAMILY:-uq_5d/universe_stage2_5d_bkgaware/uq_universe_5d_covariance_combined_bkgaware.root}"
    53	EVID="active_universe_5d/standard/evidence"
    54	CAND="active_universe_5d/standard/candidate"    # candidate outputs only (never adopted paths)
    55	run(){ echo "[p4-std] STAGE $*"; "$@" || { echo "[p4-std] ABORT at: $*"; exit 1; }; }
    56

    58	run bash run_p4_merge_audit_std.sh
    59	[[ "${STOP_AFTER}" == "audit" ]] && { echo "[p4-std] stop after merge+audit (safe preflight; nothing written)"; exit 0; }
    60	run bash run_p4_unfold_std.sh
    61	[[ "${STOP_AFTER}" == "unfold" ]] && { echo "[p4-std] stop after unfold"; exit 0; }
    62	run env P4_CODE_REV="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" python3 p4_evidence.py
    63	[[ "${STOP_AFTER}" == "evidence" ]] && { echo "[p4-std] stop after evidence (covariance gated on verifier PASS)"; exit 0; }
    64	
    65	# ---- covariance stages: authorized ONLY after standard-p4-verifier PASS ----
    66	# REPAIR-6 closes KNOWN_ISSUES #21. This used to be `[[ -z "${P4_VERIFIER_PASS}" ]]` -- any
    67	# non-empty string opened stages 4-6, and the refusal message named the variable to set, so the
    68	# failure mode was not "agent guesses the bypass" but "gate documents its own bypass". It was
    69	# demonstrated load-bearing 2026-08-07: self-authorizing would have written a candidate ROOT at
    70	# stage 4 and died at stage 5.
    71	#
    72	# The token is now the SHA256 OF A COMMITTED VERIFIER VERDICT, resolved by
    73	# p4_check_verifier_token.py, which requires: the digest matches an actual receipt; that receipt
    74	# is tracked and identical to its committed blob; verdict == PASS; the reviewed commit is an
    75	# ANCESTOR of HEAD; and every file that verdict reviewed is byte-identical between the reviewed
    76	# commit and HEAD. (Not `code_rev == HEAD` -- that broke whenever another lane pushed anything.)
    77	# Note what this does NOT claim -- it cannot stop someone committing a falsified verdict. It
    78	# moves the act from setting an invisible variable to committing a false receipt into the ledger
    79	# under their own name, which is the difference between an accident and a decision.
    80	if [[ -z "${P4_VERIFIER_PASS}" ]]; then
    81	  echo "[p4-std] HARD GATE: covariance construction requires P4_VERIFIER_PASS = sha256 of a"
    82	  echo "         committed standard-p4-verifier verdict: PASS, reviewed commit an ancestor of"

     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# STANDARD P4 stage-3: TRANSACTIONAL, resumable endpoint unfolds (repair round 3).
     3	# Bare-background (no nested srun) under one outer `srun --overlap --jobid=<holder>`.
     4	# Per endpoint: unique temp path -> content/config validation -> ATOMIC rename of the
     5	# ROOT -> write the receipt LAST (so a receipt implies a fully-published ROOT). Nominal
     6	# unfold (NO --universe), FIXED --seed 42 (MAT +/- cancels CV). Resume rules:
     7	#   * .done receipt present + ROOT valid + receipt CONTENT-validated -> skip
     8	#   * otherwise                                                      -> (re)run transactionally
     9	# Never a key-only/size-only skip. Aggregates every worker exit; requires the EXACT
    10	# 10-tag inventory, rejecting extras as well as omissions; fail-closed.
    11	#
    12	# 2026-08-07 (G-1): --bkg-mode is passed EXPLICITLY (from P4Config, not hardcoded) and stamped
    13	# into every receipt. The value is `purity` per the 2026-08-07 footing decision, which is also
    14	# the driver default -- so this changes provenance, not physics.
    15	#
    16	# REPAIR-6 corrects a claim this header used to make. It said the produced ROOTs "must hash
    17	# identically to the 2026-07-18 ones", and that is FALSE: these ROOTs are not bit-reproducible
    18	# (KNOWN_ISSUES #24 -- measured 0/10 sha256 match on a clean re-unfold, contents agreeing to
    19	# 1.9e-11 per bin and 2.6e-14 on the integral, from LightGBM/OpenMP reduction order). Sameness
    20	# of a re-run is a CONTENT question at a declared tolerance (p4_lib.check_reproducibility,
    21	# REPRO_RTOL_PER_BIN / REPRO_RTOL_INTEGRAL), never a hash question. The legacy-attest resume
    22	# rule that depended on the false assumption is deleted; see the comment in unfold_one().
    23	set -o pipefail
    24	export HOME=/global/homes/j/josephrb
    25	REPO="/pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/MINERvA-OmniFold"; ND="${REPO}/nd-unfolding"
    26	BANDS=(BeamAngleX BeamAngleY MuonResolution Muon_Energy_MINERvA Muon_Energy_MINOS)
    27	MERGEDIR="${ND}/active_universe_5d/standard/merged"
    28	OUTDIR="${ND}/active_universe_5d/standard/unfolds"; mkdir -p "${OUTDIR}"
    29	# (no MANIFEST variable: its only consumer was the deleted legacy-attest path)
    30	CONC="${CONC:-4}"
    31	cd "${ND}"
    32	CFG_HASH=$(python3 -c "import p4_lib; c=p4_lib.P4Config(); c.validate(); print(c.hash())") || { echo "[p4-unfold] ABORT config"; exit 2; }
    33	# G-1 (2026-08-07): the background footing is passed EXPLICITLY, never inherited from the
    34	# driver default. Read from P4Config (validated above) rather than hardcoded here, so the
    35	# launcher and the manifest cannot drift apart. `purity` is also the driver default, so this
    36	# is a provenance change and a physics NO-OP: it must not move any output ROOT hash.
    37	BKG_MODE=$(python3 -c "import p4_lib; c=p4_lib.P4Config(); c.validate(); print(c.bkg_mode)") || { echo "[p4-unfold] ABORT bkg_mode"; exit 2; }
    38	CODE_REV=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
    39	# repair-5 (D2): stamp the PRODUCING driver's committed blob into every receipt, so the resume
    40	# gate can COMPARE source identity instead of merely observing that code_rev is non-empty.
    41	UNFOLD_BLOB=$(git rev-parse "HEAD:nd-unfolding/unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.py" 2>/dev/null)
    42	[[ -n "${CODE_REV}" && -n "${UNFOLD_BLOB}" ]] || { echo "[p4-unfold] ABORT cannot resolve code_rev/unfold blob"; exit 2; }
    43	echo "[p4-unfold] start $(date -u +%T) CONC=${CONC} config_hash=${CFG_HASH} bkg_mode=${BKG_MODE}"

    45	valid_root(){ python3 -c "import ROOT,sys; f=ROOT.TFile.Open('$1'); sys.exit(0 if (f and not f.IsZombie() and not f.TestBit(ROOT.TFile.kRecovered) and f.Get('hXSecND_flat') and f.Get('hXSecND_flat').GetNbinsX()==65856) else 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
    46	sha(){ python3 -c "import p4_lib;print(p4_lib.sha256_file('$1'))" 2>/dev/null; }

    48	unfold_one(){
    49	  local BAND="$1" EP="$2" tag="${1}_${2}"
    50	  local MERGED="${MERGEDIR}/runEventLoopOmniFold_5D_MEFHC_active_${tag}.root"
    51	  local OUT="${OUTDIR}/5d_xsec_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm_uni_full_${tag}.root"
    52	  local REC="${OUT}.done"
    53	  # D2a: the skip is now CONTENT-validating. A ROOT plus any nonempty .done used to be enough;
    54	  # p4_check_receipt.py re-derives root/central/config/bkg_mode identities live and compares the
    55	  # merged sha against the orchestrator receipt. A reject falls through and re-runs the endpoint.
    56	  if [[ -s "${OUT}" && -s "${REC}" ]] && valid_root "${OUT}"; then
    57	    if RCHK=$(python3 p4_check_receipt.py --receipt "${REC}" --tag "${tag}" \
    58	                --root "${OUT}" --merged "${MERGED}" 2>&1); then
    59	      echo "[unfold] SKIP ${tag} (receipt validated)"; return 0
    60	    fi
    61	    echo "[unfold] STALE ${tag} -> re-running: ${RCHK}"
    62	    rm -f "${REC}"                       # D2: never leave a stale ROOT/receipt pair behind
    63	  fi
    64	  # REPAIR-6: the LEGACY-ATTEST path is DELETED, not repaired.
    65	  #
    66	  # It matched a legacy ROOT's sha256 against the committed manifest and then wrote a receipt
    67	  # stamped with the CURRENT code_rev and unfold_blob -- asserting that today's driver produced
    68	  # a file made on 2026-07-18 by an older one. That is a provenance lie, and guarding it would
    69	  # only have made the lie harder to see (repair-5 verifier finding 1, and the same class as
    70	  # KNOWN_ISSUES #23 and BEN-043's "a checkpoint is not provenance unless something asserts it
    71	  # reproduces the product").
    72	  #
    73	  # A second, independent reason it had to go: attestation-by-hash rested on the endpoint ROOTs
    74	  # being bit-reproducible, and they are NOT (KNOWN_ISSUES #24, measured 2026-08-07 -- 0/10
    75	  # sha256 match on a clean re-unfold while contents agreed to 1.9e-11 per bin and 2.6e-14 on
    76	  # the integral). So "re-unfold and compare hashes" could never have succeeded; the path could
    77	  # only ever certify that a file had not changed on disk, which is storage integrity, not
    78	  # provenance.
    79	  #
    80	  # The replacement is not a better guard -- it is removing the need for one. Every endpoint is
    81	  # PRODUCED by this launcher, so the receipt's producer claim is true by construction. The ten
    82	  # 2026-07-18 ROOTs are preserved under unfolds__SUPERSEDED_20260718/ and are never read here.
    83	  [[ ! -s "${MERGED}" ]] && { echo "[unfold] ABORT ${tag} merged missing"; return 3; }
    84	  local TMP="${OUT}.$$.${RANDOM}.tmp.root"
    85	  rm -f "${TMP}"
    86	  # `-u`: unbuffered. On this Lustre filesystem st_blksize is 4 MiB, so a buffered redirect
    87	  # shows ZERO progress for the whole run and liveness has to be inferred from sstat
    88	  # instead (BEN-028). Cost me an hour of blind watching on the 2026-08-07 probe run.
    89	  if python3 -u unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.py --omnifile "${MERGED}" --axes eavail,q3,W \
    90	       --iters 5 --use-weights --estimator lgbm --seed 42 --bkg-mode "${BKG_MODE}" \
    91	       --out "${TMP}" --verbose \
    92	       > "${OUTDIR}/unfold_${tag}.log" 2>&1 && valid_root "${TMP}"; then
    93	    local MH CH RH; MH=$(sha "${MERGED}"); CH=$(sha "products/5d/xsec_5d_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm.root")
    94	    mv -f "${TMP}" "${OUT}"; RH=$(sha "${OUT}")                       # atomic ROOT publish
    95	    # D2c: this used to be an unchecked `printf … && mv`, so a failed receipt write still fell
    96	    # through to `echo DONE` and returned 0 -- a published ROOT with no receipt, reported as
    97	    # success. The write is now the function's success condition.
    98	    if ! { printf '{"tag":"%s","mode":"produced","root_sha256":"%s","merged_sha256":"%s","central5d_sha256":"%s","config_hash":"%s","bkg_mode":"%s","bkg_mode_basis":"passed explicitly to the driver by this launcher","code_rev":"%s","unfold_blob":"%s","t":"%s"}\n' \
    99	      "${tag}" "${RH}" "${MH}" "${CH}" "${CFG_HASH}" "${BKG_MODE}" "${CODE_REV}" "${UNFOLD_BLOB}" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "${REC}.tmp" && mv -f "${REC}.tmp" "${REC}"; }; then
   100	      echo "[unfold] FAIL ${tag} receipt publication failed after ROOT publish"; rm -f "${REC}.tmp"; return 8
   101	    fi
   102	    echo "[unfold] DONE ${tag}"
   103	  else
   104	    echo "[unfold] FAIL ${tag} (see unfold_${tag}.log)"; rm -f "${TMP}"; return 4
   105	  fi
   106	}
   107	
   108	declare -A RC
   109	for BAND in "${BANDS[@]}"; do for EP in 0 1; do
   110	  while [ "$(jobs -rp | wc -l)" -ge "$CONC" ]; do sleep 8; done
   111	  ( unfold_one "${BAND}" "${EP}" ) & RC["${BAND}_${EP}"]=$!
   112	done; done
   113	fail=0
   114	for tag in "${!RC[@]}"; do wait "${RC[$tag]}" || { echo "[p4-unfold] worker FAILED: ${tag}"; fail=1; }; done
   115

   117	missing=0
   118	for BAND in "${BANDS[@]}"; do for EP in 0 1; do
   119	  t="${BAND}_${EP}"; [[ -s "${OUTDIR}/5d_xsec_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm_uni_full_${t}.root" && -s "${OUTDIR}/5d_xsec_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm_uni_full_${t}.root.done" ]] || { echo "[p4-unfold] MISSING published ${t}"; missing=1; }
   120	done; done
   121	# D2d: the loop above only asks whether the ten EXPECTED tags exist, so an eleventh product in
   122	# the directory was invisible to it. Reject extras as well as missing -- an unexplained endpoint
   123	# in a publication namespace is exactly the state this lane spent three weeks in.
   124	extras=0
   125	LIVE_TAGS=$(ls "${OUTDIR}"/5d_xsec_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm_uni_full_*.root 2>/dev/null \
   126	  | sed -e 's#.*uni_full_##' -e 's#\.root$##' | sort)
   127	python3 -c "
   128	import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
   129	import p4_lib as P
   130	tags=[t for t in sys.stdin.read().split() if t]
   131	P.require_exact_endpoint_tags(tags)
   132	" <<< "${LIVE_TAGS}" || { echo "[p4-unfold] EXTRA/UNEXPECTED endpoint products present"; extras=1; }
   133	if [[ "${fail}" -ne 0 || "${missing}" -ne 0 || "${extras}" -ne 0 ]]; then echo "[p4-unfold] FAIL-CLOSED (worker fail, incomplete inventory, or extra products)"; exit 5; fi

   249	# ---- source provenance: git blobs of code + binary digest + per-file source commits ----
   250	import subprocess
   251	# REPAIR-4 (verifier defect 3b/3c, and KNOWN_ISSUES #23). These used to hash the WORKING TREE
   252	# (`git hash-object <path>`), so the manifest recorded whatever happened to be checked out --
   253	# which is how an unrelated dirty OmniFold blob was absorbed in 2026-07, and how re-running
   254	# evidence in 2026-08 silently re-attributed 07-18 endpoints to a newer driver and binary.
   255	# Now: hash the COMMITTED object at HEAD, record the commit that introduced that exact blob,
   256	# and fail closed if the working tree differs from HEAD for any bound path -- because a
   257	# provenance record that can disagree with what actually ran is worse than none.
   258	def _committed_blob(rel):
   259	    """The blob sha of `rel` as committed at HEAD (not the working-tree copy)."""
   260	    try:
   261	        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"HEAD:{rel}"],
   262	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   263	    except Exception:
   264	        return None
   265	def _worktree_blob(rel):
   266	    try:
   267	        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "hash-object", rel],
   268	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   269	    except Exception:
   270	        return None
   271	def _blob_introducing_commit(rel, blob):
   272	    """The most recent commit whose version of `rel` IS `blob`. The old code recorded
   273	    `git log -1 -- <rel>`, i.e. the last commit to touch the path, which need not be the commit
   274	    that introduced the blob it recorded beside it."""
   275	    if not blob:
   276	        return None
   277	    try:
   278	        revs = subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "--format=%H", "--", rel],
   279	                                       cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).split()
   280	        for r in revs:
   281	            try:
   282	                b = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", f"{r}:{rel}"],
   283	                                            cwd=REPO, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
   284	            except Exception:
   285	                continue
   286	            if b == blob:
   287	                return r
   288	    except Exception:
   289	        pass
   290	    return None

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Bind P4_VERIFIER_PASS to a real verifier verdict (closes KNOWN_ISSUES #21 / inventory A1).
     3	
     4	The gate at `run_p4_standard.sh:41` tested only `[[ -z "${P4_VERIFIER_PASS}" ]]`, so ANY
     5	non-empty string authorized covariance construction, and the refusal message named the variable
     6	to set. It was demonstrated load-bearing on 2026-08-07: an autonomous run that self-authorized
     7	would have written a candidate ROOT at stage 4 and died at stage 5, because stages 4-6 had never
     8	executed and were broken three independent ways.
     9	
    10	**The fix is deliberately not "check the variable harder."** An agent that can set an env var
    11	can also write a JSON file, so a token bound to a file the agent could create is no gate at all.
    12	The token must resolve to a verdict that is:
    13	
    14	  1. a file whose sha256 EQUALS the token                     (the token is not a password,
    15	                                                               it is the digest of the evidence)
    16	  2. TRACKED in git and identical to its committed blob        (so it cannot be fabricated in the
    17	                                                               working tree, and reviewing it is
    18	                                                               reviewing what authorized the run)
    19	  3. `verdict == "PASS"`                                       (BLOCK/absent authorizes nothing)
    20	  4a. `code_rev` is an ANCESTOR of HEAD                        (the verdict came from this
    21	                                                               history, not a foreign branch)
    22	  4b. every file the verdict REVIEWED is byte-identical        (a PASS cannot authorize code the
    23	      between that commit and HEAD                              verifier never saw)
    24	
    25	Rule 4 was originally `code_rev == HEAD`, which broke on correct behaviour: any push by another
    26	lane between the PASS and stages 4-6 invalidated a good verdict over commits touching nothing
    27	reviewed. 4a+4b is strictly stronger -- it checks what the rule protects instead of a proxy that
    28	unrelated commits perturb. Scope comes from the verdict's `review_scope` if declared, else the
    29	whole standard-P4 surface, which is the wider and safer default.
    30	
    31	That still does not make forgery impossible -- someone can commit a fake verdict -- but it moves
    32	the act from "set a variable nobody will ever see" to "commit a falsified receipt into the
    33	ledger under your own name," which is the difference between an accident and a decision.
    34	
    35	Usage:  p4_check_verifier_token.py --token <sha256>
    36	Exit 0 and print the resolved receipt path, or print TOKEN-REJECT :: <reason> and exit 1.
    37	"""
    38	import argparse, glob, json, os, subprocess, sys
    39	
    40	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    41	import p4_lib as P
    42	
    43	RECEIPT_DIR = os.path.join(P.REPO_ROOT, "docs", "orchestration", "runs", "standard-p4-verifier")
    44	
    45	
    46	def _git(*args):
    47	    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=P.REPO_ROOT, text=True,
    48	                                   stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
    49	
    50	
    51	def resolve(token):
    52	    if not token or not token.strip():
    53	        raise P.P4GateError("empty token")
    54	    token = token.strip().lower()
    55	    if len(token) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in token):
    56	        raise P.P4GateError(
    57	            f"token is not a sha256 ({len(token)} chars). The token must be the digest of a "
    58	            f"committed standard-p4-verifier verdict, not a passphrase.")
    59	    if not os.path.isdir(RECEIPT_DIR):
    60	        raise P.P4GateError(f"no verifier receipt directory at {RECEIPT_DIR}")
    61	
    62	    head = _git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    63	    matches = []
    64	    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(RECEIPT_DIR, "*.json"))):
    65	        if P.sha256_file(p) == token:
    66	            matches.append(p)
    67	    if not matches:
    68	        raise P.P4GateError(
    69	            f"no verdict in {os.path.relpath(RECEIPT_DIR, P.REPO_ROOT)} has sha256 {token[:16]}… "
    70	            f"-- the token must be the digest of an actual receipt")
    71	    if len(matches) > 1:
    72	        raise P.P4GateError(f"token matches {len(matches)} receipts; ambiguous")
    73	    path = matches[0]
    74	    rel = os.path.relpath(path, P.REPO_ROOT)
    75	
    76	    # (2) tracked AND unmodified -- a receipt invented in the working tree must not authorize
    77	    try:
    78	        _git("ls-files", "--error-unmatch", rel)
    79	    except Exception:
    80	        raise P.P4GateError(f"{rel} is not tracked in git; an untracked verdict authorizes nothing")
    81	    committed = _git("rev-parse", f"HEAD:{rel}")
    82	    worktree = _git("hash-object", rel)
    83	    if committed != worktree:
    84	        raise P.P4GateError(
    85	            f"{rel} differs from its committed blob (working {worktree[:12]} vs committed "
    86	            f"{committed[:12]}); the authorizing verdict must be the reviewed one")
    87	
    88	    v = json.load(open(path))
    89	    # (3) verdict
    90	    if str(v.get("verdict", "")).upper() != "PASS":
    91	        raise P.P4GateError(
    92	            f"{rel} records verdict={v.get('verdict')!r}, not PASS -- this authorizes nothing")
    93	    # (4) REPAIR-6c. This required `code_rev == HEAD` and was wrong for the same reason the
    94	    # receipt gate was: it breaks on CORRECT behaviour. Another lane pushing between the verifier
    95	    # PASS and stages 4-6 -- which happened today, eight commits mid-run -- would reject a valid
    96	    # verdict over commits touching nothing the verifier reviewed.
    97	    #
    98	    # Replaced by a pair that is STRICTLY STRONGER than equality, because it checks the thing the
    99	    # rule protects rather than a proxy unrelated commits perturb:
   100	    #   (4a) the reviewed commit must be an ANCESTOR of HEAD -- catches a verdict carried in from
   101	    #        a foreign branch or a rewritten history;
   102	    #   (4b) every file the verdict actually REVIEWED must be byte-identical between that commit
   103	    #        and HEAD -- so a PASS cannot authorize code the verifier never saw.
   104	    # The verdict may declare its own scope in `review_scope`; absent that, the fallback is every
   105	    # tracked file on the standard-P4 surface, the wider and therefore safer assumption.
   106	    cr = v.get("code_rev")
   107	    if not cr:
   108	        raise P.P4GateError(f"{rel} records no code_rev; cannot tell which patch it passed")
   109	    cr = str(cr).strip()
   110	    if not P.code_rev_in_history(cr):
   111	        raise P.P4GateError(
   112	            f"{rel} passed code_rev {cr[:12]}, which is not an ancestor of HEAD ({head[:12]}). "
   113	            f"That verdict did not come from this repository's history.")
   114	
   115	    scope = v.get("review_scope")
   116	    if isinstance(scope, list) and scope:
   117	        paths, scope_src = sorted(str(x) for x in scope), "declared review_scope"
   118	    else:
   119	        # REPAIR-7 item 2: derived from the IMPORT GRAPH, not a filename glob. The glob omitted
   120	        # uq_math, project_cov_nd, unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned, xsec_nd and omnifold -- i.e. the
   121	        # code that actually runs -- so a verdict could authorize materially changed execution.
   122	        paths = P.standard_p4_execution_surface()
   123	        scope_src = "default standard-P4 EXECUTION surface (%d tracked modules)" % len(paths)
   124	    if not paths:
   125	        raise P.P4GateError("could not resolve a review scope; refusing to authorize blind")
   126	    ok, differing = P.paths_unchanged_between(cr, head, paths)
   127	    if not ok:
   128	        raise P.P4GateError(
   129	            f"{rel} reviewed {cr[:12]}, but {len(differing)} file(s) it covered have CHANGED at "
   130	            f"HEAD ({head[:12]}): {', '.join(differing[:4])}"
   131	            f"{' ...' if len(differing) > 4 else ''}. A PASS cannot authorize code the verifier "
   132	            f"never saw; re-run the verifier.")
   133	    v["_resolved_review_scope"] = scope_src
   134	    if v.get("authorizes_covariance_stages_4_6") is False:
   135	        raise P.P4GateError(f"{rel} explicitly sets authorizes_covariance_stages_4_6=false")
   136	    return rel, v
   137	
   138	
   139	def main():
   140	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   141	    ap.add_argument("--token", required=True)
   142	    a = ap.parse_args()
   143	    try:
   144	        rel, v = resolve(a.token)
   145	    except P.P4GateError as e:
   146	        print(f"TOKEN-REJECT :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   147	    except Exception as e:
   148	        print(f"TOKEN-REJECT :: unexpected {type(e).__name__}: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   149	    print(f"TOKEN-OK :: {rel} (verdict=PASS, code_rev={v.get('code_rev')})")
   150	    sys.exit(0)
   151	
   152	
   153	if __name__ == "__main__":
   154	    main()
     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Endpoint-receipt gate for run_p4_unfold_std.sh's resume path (repair-4, verifier defect 2).
     3	
     4	Exit 0 iff the receipt is complete and every recorded identity matches the live/committed one;
     5	otherwise print `RECEIPT-REJECT :: <reason>` and exit 1, which makes the launcher re-run the
     6	endpoint transactionally instead of skipping it.
     7	
     8	Deliberately a separate CLI rather than inline `python3 -c` in the launcher: the previous skip
     9	logic was an unreadable one-liner, and a gate that cannot be unit-tested is the defect this
    10	whole repair round exists to remove. ROOT-free -- content validity of the ROOT itself is the
    11	launcher's `valid_root`, this is the provenance half.
    12	
    13	Usage:
    14	  p4_check_receipt.py --receipt R.done --tag BAND_EP --root OUT.root --merged MERGED.root
    15	"""
    16	import argparse, json, os, sys
    17	
    18	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    19	import p4_lib as P
    20	
    21	REPO = P.REPO_ROOT
    22	ND = P.ND_ROOT
    23	CEN5 = f"{ND}/products/5d/xsec_5d_MEFHC_5iter_lgbm.root"
    24	RECDIR = f"{REPO}/docs/orchestration/state/merged-input-hashes/p4-merged-20260718"
    25	UNFOLD_SRC = "nd-unfolding/unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.py"
    26
